title: Project fixed-values registry
description: Values that differ per project and must not overlap. Sync does not overwrite them. Ports follow the portScheme formula in registry/platform.json (base + slot).

nullableHost.description: null if undecided. Fill in only the value once decided.

title.description: Name used in docs and instructions (e.g. Study Log)

displayName.description: App display name used in the screen header, tab title, and PWA name. Apps are told apart only by this name, so it must not overlap (ADR-0008)

domain.description: Description of the service area (e.g. exercise)

summary.description: Service description used in the first paragraph of AGENTS.md

public.description: The umbrella repo is public. A public repo cannot call reusable workflows in the private central repo, so the shared CI is expanded inline in ci.yml (#209)

prefix.description: AWS resource name prefix. null if undecided

e2e.description: Uses Playwright browser tests. Turns on the CI e2e job and the playwright.config.ts template (templates/e2e) (#33)

e2eVisual.description: Runs e2e in a Playwright container pinned by digest (versions.json images.playwright) with E2E_VISUAL=1 and compares screenshots. Turn on only when e2e and the db:migrate runner exist (#203)

ui.description: Syncs the shared UI components (templates/ui). Turn on after installing dependencies such as radix-ui in the app (#123, #126)

vitest.description: Syncs the component test setup frontend/vitest.config.ts (templates/vitest). Turn on after installing vitest, jsdom, and Testing Library (#33)

devcontainer.description: Syncs the Dev Container setup for a new PC (.devcontainer/, templates/devcontainer). Node uses versions.json images.devcontainerNode, and the DB uses the db service in the app's compose.yaml (#282)

lighthouse.description: Measures the frontend built in CI (frontend/dist) with Lighthouse CI and only warns on a missed threshold. Syncs lighthouserc.json (templates/lighthouse). Turn on after installing @lhci/cli at the app root (#280)

msw.description: Component tests run without a backend, using MSW mocks of the OpenAPI contract (docs/openapi.json). Syncs frontend/src/test/contract-api.ts (templates/msw). Turn on when openapi and vitest are on and msw is installed in frontend (#281)

knipStrict.description: The CI knip step fails if it reports anything. When off, it only warns. Turn on only for apps whose npm run knip result is 0 (#342)

darkOnly.description: The app uses dark mode only. It renders dark from the first paint, hides the theme menu, and uses a dark background for PWA colors. When off, users choose light, dark, or system (ADR-0011, #354)

claude.description: The backend uses the Claude API. The deploy script reads ANTHROPIC_API_KEY from AWS SSM and passes it on, and the central command tools/app-secrets.mjs puts it in the local .env (ADR-0010, #265)
